name: PPO (tuned)
description: PPO tuned over a declared grid of 8 configurations (learning_rate: [0.0003, 0.001]; net_arch: [[64, 64], [128, 128]]; episode_length: [252, 63]; gamma: [0.99, 0.95]), all other parameters as in the 'ppo' submission. One configuration is shared by all tasks and was selected on validation data only: the highest mean across tasks (us-sectors, us-multi-asset, crypto-majors) of the rank of its seed-averaged validation Sharpe ratio; the test window was never used for selection. Selected: {"episode_length": 63, "gamma": 0.95, "learning_rate": 0.0003, "net_arch": [64, 64]}. trials = 8. Every configuration's scores are in sweep.json.
